description: Establish and record the green exact-tree baseline on branch feature/customer-experience-upgrade (base 51445762) before any change, so regressions are attributable. No source changes.
steps: Confirm the working tree is clean and the branch is feature/customer-experience-upgrade: `git status`, `git branch --show-current`, `git rev-parse HEAD` (expect 51445762 or later task commits).
Run the backend suite: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and record the true pass/skip counts (baseline ~5757 passed/1 skipped).
Run `npx vitest run` and record the true pass count (baseline ~684 passed).

Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0 and the sitemap URL count (~1407). If it fails on a transient upstream blog 429 during /post/[slug] export, re-run once to confirm exit 0 - do NOT weaken the build's fail-hard safety.
Record all four counts in this feature's findings. Do NOT commit anything in this feature (no source change).
acceptance_criteria: pytest, tsc --noEmit, vitest and npm run build all pass on the untouched tree and their true counts are recorded in findings.
No files were modified or committed.
verification: npm run build (re-run once if the only failure is a transient blog 429)
findings: Baseline on branch feature/customer-experience-upgrade @ HEAD 51445762 (clean tree), measured in sandbox (node v22.23.3 at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin; .venv python3.12): pytest = 6001 passed, 1 skipped, 1 warning (42.66s); tsc --noEmit = exit 0; vitest run = 698 passed / 50 files; npm run build = exit 0, 1407 sitemap URLs (1321 blog posts), no transient 429 this run. NOTE: counts are HIGHER than the orchestrator briefing's ~5757 pytest / ~684 vitest / ~1407 build - the repo has advanced; these 6001/698/1407 are the authoritative green baseline to compare against after changes. No source modified, nothing committed. TOOLING NOTE for coder subagents: npm/npx are NOT on the default shell PATH; prefix commands with `export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"` (or call node_modules/.bin/tsc and node_modules/.bin/vitest directly). Python via .venv/bin/python.
